long_biography.plain_text:
A law degree from Leningrad State University preceded Vladimir Putin's career in Soviet state security, including an assignment in East Germany. Returning to Leningrad, he worked at the university and then in the city administration. There he chaired the international relations committee and became first deputy head of government.

A move to Moscow placed Putin in the presidential administration. He led the Federal Security Service, joined the Security Council and became prime minister, then acting president after Boris Yeltsin resigned. Putin served two presidential terms before returning to the premiership, and resumed the presidency four years later. He began his current term in May 2024.
